ruff.command: python -m ruff check tests/test_live_uploads.py tests/test_worker_consent_revocation.py tests/test_foundation.py

ruff_format.command: python -m ruff format --check tests/test_live_uploads.py tests/test_worker_consent_revocation.py tests/test_foundation.py

faults_exercised: ENOSPC during upload fsync; offset remains uncommitted and retry succeeds.
SQLite writer lock during upload commit; request maps to retryable storage error.
Delayed fsync; the upload offset remains unchanged until durable flush completes.
Client disconnect while streaming a chunk; partial bytes are not committed.
Missing source media; ingest job fails without result/transcript publication.
Abrupt process exit inside an open SQLite transaction; database integrity recovers and uncommitted row is absent.
Consent withdrawal before and during ingest; processing is cancelled and no result is published.
ASR backend and media decoder timeouts; failures remain typed and fail closed.
limitations: The eight requested fault classes are covered at representative application seams, not injected at every lifecycle stage.
No physical disk exhaustion, host power loss, real network disconnect, or production/PostgreSQL fault test was performed.
Drafting, verification, approval, and export need a complete cross-stage fault matrix; some individual fail-closed tests exist elsewhere but are not a full matrix.
